author: TheCreeperFace08
body:
IGN's: TheCreeperFace08 & InspirAsian135

Reason for ban: TheCreeperFace08: Ban evading InspirAsian135: anti kb (InspirAsian135 was banned first)

Why I should be unbanned: I still truly believe this is one big misunderstanding, I was NOT ban evading because TheCreeperFace08 is my cousin's account and he let us use it because he didn't use it as often. So, after about 1-2 years of using TheCreeperFace08, me and my siblings decided to buy an account that we have full control over it (InspirAsian135). The day after we purchased the new account (InspirAsian135) we were banned (anti-knockback) even though we don't hack, and we also want to see the video that was taken of us "hacking" because it's not fair that we got banned because of this, but don't get to see the actual proof. TheCreeperFace08 was banned because you guys thought that we used that account to ban evade. Which we did not. Also, ban evading means that you have 1 account, just one, that you would hack or spam with, then when you get banned, you buy another account to play with. TheCreeperFace08 was made in 2014 and TheCreeperFace08 was never banned for hacking. If we were ban evading,It wouldn't make sense to make an effort to unban that account that was used for spamming/advertising or hacking. Let me know if you want proof that TheCreeperFace08 was made in 2014.

title: TheCreeperFace08 & InspirAsian135 ban appeal

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello TheCreeperFace08 & Inspirasian135,

Even if your cousin did let you use it that still counts as ban evading. Your logs indicate that it is InspirAsian135 and not your cousin. Ban Evading is using any account to evade a punishment on another account, it doesn't matter if it was bought yesterday or 3 years ago. Your still using an account to evade a punishment. However that being said i'm not going to close this appeal because i want to determine whether or not you were actually hacking. I will review the evidence, show you it if there is any and i will then come up with a decision.

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
